annotations.title: Domain WHOIS, DNS and email audit

description: WHOIS plus DNS records (A, MX, NS, TXT) and an SPF/DMARC email-security audit for a domain. Use it to profile a company's web estate or check its email posture. include_dns and include_security toggle the two halves.

domain.description: Domain name to look up (e.g. 'example.com'); a URL is reduced to its host.
domain.title: Domain

include_dns.description: Include DNS records (A, AAAA, MX, NS, TXT, SOA); default true.
include_dns.title: Include Dns

include_security.description: Include the SPF/DMARC email-security check; default true.
include_security.title: Include Security

name: lookup_domain

outputSchema.description: WHOIS, DNS records and the SPF/DMARC audit of a domain.

dns.description: Records by type: A, AAAA, MX, NS, TXT, SOA.

error.description: Set only when there is no answer (empty_query, invalid_cui, data_unavailable, plan_required ...); such a call is not counted.

resolvedIP.description: An address the domain resolves to.

whois.description: registrar, creationDate, expirationDate, updatedDate, nameServers, registrantOrg, registrantCountry.

title: Domain WHOIS, DNS and email audit
